units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 22">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXII</cite> <he>אותה ק׳</he> ed. Bub. (ed. <he>הקְפָצָה</he>), v. <cite ref="S01764"><he>קָפַץ</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 687">Yalk. ib. 687</cite>.—Pl. <he>קְפִיצוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 5:6:4">Y. Succ. V, 55ᶜ</cite> top <he>היה … בקְפִיצוֹתָיו</he> prided himself on his leaping performances.
<cite ref="Eruvin 43a:11">Erub. 43ᵃ</cite> <he>רקאזיל בק׳</he> he traversed a large distance by miraculous flight; <cite ref="Yevamot 116a">Yeb. 116ᵃ</cite>

senses.gloss: [closing of lips,] mimic intimation of, or to a deaf and dumb person.—Pl. as ab.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 71a:11">Gitt. 71ᵃ</cite> <he>לא הלכו … ואחר קפיצותיו וכ׳</he> we follow his intimations by hints or motions of the lips or by writing only in the disposal of chattel, but not for letters of divorce.
